'''Blue Nine''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] assigned to the ninth [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in various Blue Squadrons.

==History==
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]]<ref name="FBTB" /> during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|num=75010|name=B-wing Starfighter & Planet Endor}}</ref>

[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilot [[Dorset Konnair]] flew as Blue Nine with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Edor Crespin]]'s [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|Blue Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Folor]], she participated in the engagement under that call sign, flying her [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptor]] wing-to-wing with that of squadronmate [[Tetengo Noor]], [[Blue Ten/Legends|Blue Ten]], in a ploy to impersonate the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="XWWS" />
